links.outcome: Average reading level of reports (grade level)

links.comparator_used: Initial single prompt used without refinement
links.outcome: Omission rate of clinically relevant information in simplified reports
links.effect: Enhanced prompt maintained reading level while significantly improving omission rate (p < 0.0001)
links.tradeoff: Even with the enhanced prompt, GPT made errors regarding location of stenosis, description of prior spine surgery, and other spine pathologies
links.quote: An enhanced prompt model using high scoring reports-maintained reading level while significantly improving omission rate (p < 0.0001).
